description: Tomedo practice management system integration: fetch active patient ID from the local Tomedo client, retrieve patient data, manage ICD-10 diagnoses, check HZV billing completeness, and verify AOK P4 qualification (56544).

conditional_requirements: patient_id required for all patient actions except get_active_patient_id.
icd_code and certainty required for add_icd_code.
billing_number and description required for add_invoice_item.
quarter and year required for get_invoices and check_invoice_completeness.
notes: Run get_active_patient_id first to get the current patient from the open Tomedo window.
Use check_p4_qualification to check if 56544 should be billed.
Use scan_patient_records to find additional HZV-billable items.
Tomedo API credentials must be stored as secrets: tomedo_api_url, tomedo_username, tomedo_api_password.
The local monitor must be running (install native-plugins/tomedo-monitor) for get_active_patient_id to work.

auth.instructions:
Configure your Tomedo server connection:
1. Open Tomedo and find the REST API settings (usually under Verwaltung → Server → REST-API)
2. Note the server URL and port (e.g. http://localhost:8080 or http://192.168.1.100:8080)
3. Create or use an existing API user with appropriate permissions
4. Store these as secrets:
   - tomedo_api_url: the full base URL (e.g. http://localhost:8080)
   - tomedo_username: your API username
   - tomedo_api_password: your API password or token
5. Install and start the tomedo-monitor daemon:
   cd native-plugins/tomedo-monitor && ./install.sh

optional_secrets.name: tomedo_invoice_rules
optional_secrets.prompt: JSON array of billing rules (leave empty to use defaults)

optional_secrets.name: tomedo_p4_custom_icd_codes
optional_secrets.prompt: JSON array of additional ICD codes for P4 matching (leave empty to use built-in list)
